name: barbell weighted front chest squat
description: A squat with the barbell racked across the front of your shoulders. The front load keeps you upright and hits the quads hard.
instructions: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high and hands steadying it.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and brace your core.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your elbows up the whole way.
